name: Matteo Collura
biography: is a student of Electronics Engineering at Politecnico di Torino. He has been studying Wireless networks and in the last few years he focused on NFC. He presented the results of a progressive work of research at several conferences: DEF CON 21 (Las Vegas, 2013), 30C3 (Hamburg 2013), DEF CON Skytalks (Las Vegas, 2014), BlackHat USA 2014 Arsenal (Las Vegas). Currently he is studying Bluetooth protocols and their implementations.
